address: Marina street, Kalkara waterfront, Kalkara, KKR 1521, Malta
bio: This chic, contemporary-style lounge bar-cum-restaurant near the Grand Harbour boasts splendid vistas: on one side, you have the bay with its small harbour, and on the other, the historic town of Valletta. Even if the weather isn't favourable and you need to dine indoors, the picture windows command a lovely view. The menu unveils an intriguing mix of Asian specialities and Mediterranean dishes, together with an iconic selection of sashimi, nigiri and sushi rolls for fans of Japanese food. Perfect for a relaxing meal, with the bonus of a spacious alfresco area....
